policy.about: The course of an improvement investigation of the junior. It reads which round is under way and whether a version was trained.

composition.source: (p) => { const round = Math.max(0, ...p.events.map((e) => typeof e.round === 'number' ? e.round : 0)); if (round === 1 && !p.state.cheap) return { guidance: { kind: 'advise', focus: 'develop', template: 'cheap_first', arguments: {}, evidence: [], judgments: [] }, state: { ...p.state, cheap: true } }; if (round >= 2 && !p.state.distill) return { guidance: { kind: 'advise', focus: 'contrast', template: 'distill_first', arguments: { version: 'your latest version' }, evidence: [], judgments: [] }, state: { ...p.state, distill: true } }; return { guidance: { kind: 'abstain', reason: 'advised already' }, state: p.state }; }

provenance.reason: An example of SPEC-METAPOLITICA-APRENDIZAJE §14.1: the order of the levers of §7 as a procedure - cheap first, then distillation from cuts before training. Written by the operator before any trial; its usefulness is measured only by comparing improvement investigations (§14.2).

cheap_first.text: Try the cheapest levers first: a starting prompt or a memory file that states the protocol, evaluated once, before any distillation or training.

distill_from_cuts.text: Before training anything, look at the cuts where the junior failed in the latest evaluation of {{version}}: distill from those cuts with a checker that fixes the competence (request, rules or proposal), and build a dataset of the verified examples only. Train only on a dataset that shares no group with the selecting probes.
